editorNote: Alibaba's results lead: cloud up 53% but cash burning faster. Elsewhere, Anthropic's IPO priced, gold sat near its lowest in over a year, bitcoin's weakness was tied by one executive to IPO funding, and a Duolingo lead-plaintiff deadline looms. Facts only; none of this is investment advice.

stories.headline: Alibaba's AI cloud revenue rises 53% in the September quarter, while adjusted EPS misses and cash burn widens
stories.summary: Revenue was 271.52 billion yuan against 269.81 billion expected, with AI cloud and computing up 53% to 60.97 billion yuan. Non-GAAP net income rose 92% to 19.9 billion yuan, but adjusted earnings per ADS of 8.10 yuan were below the 11.16 yuan expected, capex rose 60% to 50.48 billion yuan and cash burn was 34.47 billion yuan.
stories.whyItMatters: China e-commerce revenue fell 5% and international fell 8%, and the CEO warned new US compute export rules will affect next year's products; US-listed shares were up 3.6% in morning trading, per Reuters.

sourceLinks.title: China's Alibaba beats quarterly revenue estimates (Reuters via KFGO)

stories.headline: Anthropic prices its Nasdaq IPO at $83 a share, above the $70–$78 range reported last week
stories.summary: The company priced 980 million shares at $83.00 on Nov. 18, expects trading as ANT to begin Nov. 19 and closing on Nov. 20. A Nov. 13 report cited by crypto.news put the earlier range at $70 to $78 with about six times as many orders as shares.
stories.whyItMatters: This is the follow-through on the filing we covered Nov. 17; Alphabet's holdings in the company, previously reported at about 28% for Amazon and Google combined, are now exposed to a public market price.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin below $70K, Xapo CEO and Anthropic IPO (crypto.news)

stories.headline: Gold stays near a 14-month low as the dollar, yields and Fed hike bets weigh
stories.summary: Trading Economics put spot gold around $3,850 an ounce on Nov. 17, the lowest since September 2025, and a later item dated Nov. 19 had it steadying above $3,700, though the page's dates and prices are inconsistent. It cites a stronger dollar, high Treasury yields, hotter October inflation and Fed officials backing rate hikes.
stories.whyItMatters: Markets were pricing over a 95% chance of a 25-basis-point hike next month, raising the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold; the page flags FOMC minutes as the next catalyst.

sourceLinks.title: Gold Hovers at Near 14-Month Low (Trading Economics)

stories.headline: Xapo Bank's CEO ties bitcoin's slide below $70,000 to funding for Anthropic's IPO
stories.summary: In a Nov. 13 report, bitcoin traded near $68,750 and Seamus Rocca attributed the dip to investors selling liquid assets to fund Anthropic subscriptions. US spot bitcoin ETFs had about $1.44 billion of withdrawals over five sessions and roughly $1.23 billion of crypto positions were liquidated in 24 hours.
stories.whyItMatters: The IPO-liquidity link is one executive's view, and the article also lists inflation worries, Strategy's Nov. 30 MSCI index removal and tech-stock selling as pressures.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin below $70K: Xapo CEO and Anthropic IPO (crypto.news)

stories.headline: Duolingo's securities class action: lead-plaintiff motions are due Dec. 7
stories.summary: Duolingo's 10-Q describes a putative class action filed Oct. 7 in the Western District of Pennsylvania covering purchasers of its Class A stock between May 2, 2025 and Feb. 26, 2026. The company says it intends to defend vigorously, and no class has been certified.
stories.whyItMatters: The Dec. 7 date only sets who may lead the suit; it is not a finding on the claims, which allege violations of Sections 10(b) and 20(a) according to one law-firm notice.
